hooks.command:
jq -c '(.tool_input.command // "") as $c
| ($ENV.ISSUE // "") as $n
| ($c | gsub("\"(?<d>[^\"]*)\"|\u0027(?<s>[^\u0027]*)\u0027"; ((.d // .s // "") as $q | if ($q | test("^[\\w./=:@-]+$")) then $q else "\"\"" end))) as $head
| if ($head | test("(^|[;&|(\n])[[:space:]]*git[[:space:]]+grep[[:space:]]+([^\n;&|]*[[:space:]\"])?(-[^-[:space:]]*O|--op)")) then
    {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "deny", permissionDecisionReason: "Do not use git grep -O or --open-files-in-pager: it runs a command on each file."}}
  elif ($head | test("gh[[:space:]]+issue[[:space:]]+(edit|comment)([[:space:]]|$)")) | not then empty
  else
    ($c | rtrimstr("\n")) as $line
    | (if $n == "" then "<n>" else $n end) as $m
    | (" --body-file /tmp/agent-body.md") as $file
    | if $n != "" and ($line == "gh issue edit " + $n + $file or $line == "gh issue comment " + $n + $file)
      then empty
      else {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "deny", permissionDecisionReason: ("Edit or comment on only issue #" + (if $n == "" then "?" else $n end) + ", as gh issue edit " + $m + $file + " or gh issue comment " + $m + $file + ", and nothing else in the call.")}}
      end
  end'

jq -c '(.tool_input.file_path // "") as $p
| if $p == "/tmp/agent-body.md" then empty
  else {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "deny", permissionDecisionReason: "Write only /tmp/agent-body.md: it holds the body of the one gh call that posts it."}}
  end'
